name: @busy-office/render-pdf-direct
description: Path A pdf-direct renderer (ADR-002 Accepted 2026-08-29): in-process pdf-lib composition for single-page, Latin-only, no-carry-forward documents. PDF/A-2b via embedded TTF + XMP + OutputIntent; veraPDF-gated in the corpus. Everything else stays Typst (ADR-001).
